english.note: Department does not accept IELTS. Linked2019 application PDF prefers TOEFLiBT100; no conversion inferred.

applicationFee.note: $60 U.S.; $70 international. Department offers no program waivers. University recruitment/other waivers have separate eligibility; international applicants should confirm applicability.

documents: Official transcript copies; certified translations if needed
requirements.note: GPA3.0/four-year bachelor equivalent; calculus, general physics/chemistry, organic chemistry, biochemistry and general biology prerequisite. Microbiology course preferred. Supplements may arrive up to two weeks after deadline. Document details from currently linked2019 instructions; confirm current.

funding.note: All qualified PhD students guaranteed first-year departmental support; later funding by advisor grants, fellowships or teaching, subject to good standing.
